🚀 Now Hiring: Field Support Representative – Level 1 | Europe | B2B Contract 
 We are looking for skilled and customer-focused Field Support Representatives (L1) to provide onsite IT support, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and maintain IT operations across office, manufacturing, laboratory, and data centre environments.
 📍 Locations: 
Brussels, Belgium
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Warsaw, Poland
Lisbon, Portugal
Bucharest, Romania
Madrid, Spain
 💼 Engagement: B2B Contract
 🏢 Work Mode: Onsite / Field Support
 📌 Experience: Minimum 2 years in desk-side IT support
 🔍 Key Skills Required 
Windows OS, MS Office, and business applications
Desktop support, hardware/software installation, and troubleshooting
IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) and break-fix support
Laptop, desktop, mobile device, handheld scanner, and printer support
Basic knowledge of LAN, Wi-Fi, networks, telecom, and compute/storage
IT asset lifecycle management, imaging, and system deployment
Data collection and preservation for migrations or eDiscovery
 🛠️ Key Responsibilities 
Provide end-user, desk-side, IMAC, and break-fix support.
Build, stage, and image systems using standard client images.
Support manufacturing shop-floor devices, laboratory equipment, scanners, tablets, and specialised PCs.
Provide smart-hands support, rack-and-stack activities, and infrastructure commissioning/decommissioning assistance.
Coordinate vendor access to communication rooms and data centres.
Support planned power shutdowns and maintenance activities involving network devices and servers.
Coordinate cable patching and maintain LAN, Wi-Fi, voice, video conferencing, and printing services.
Manage IT assets, including collection, labelling, imaging, allocation, recovery, secure storage, and disposal.
Collaborate with internal teams and OEMs to resolve high-priority issues.
 ⭐ Preferred Profile 
Experience in manufacturing, laboratory, clean-room, or distribution centre IT environments.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.
Knowledge of Microsoft server support and enterprise IT infrastructure.
High attention to detail and a strong focus on quality.
 📩 Interested? DM me on LinkedIn.
 📧 Send your updated CV to: chethan.as@intelligenzit.com
